title: Gary Webb and CIA cocaine in the inner city

tellings.quote:
Gary Webb, the guy that knew the CIA
brought Coke into the hood.

plain: Kurt Metzger, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, brings up a man named Gary Webb, whom he calls "the guy that knew the CIA brought Coke into the hood." The CIA is America's foreign spy agency, and Metzger's point is that Webb found it had let cocaine flow into poor American neighborhoods, in a story running from the 1980s to 2004. He tells it as an example of the government hiding dark secrets from the public.
